profile.name: 通用VXI-11实验仪器
profile.description: 通过VXI-11协议进行远程通信的通用实验室仪器，通常用于示波器、信号源、频谱分析仪、数字万用表等可编程测试测量设备的控制与数据采集。
profile.description_en: A generic laboratory instrument that communicates over the VXI-11 protocol, typically used for programmable test and measurement devices such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and digital multimeters for remote control and data acquisition.
